name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: Mayon at Level 3; no red aviation codes
summary: No red aviation codes, large eruptions or ash closures found as of 10 Nov; Mayon remains at Alert Level 3
state: The weekly report for 22–28 Oct listed new activity at five volcanoes and ongoing activity at 23, with no red aviation code or plume above 10 km (The Watchers). Mayon has been at Alert Level 3 since 30 Oct, and Marapi in Sumatra sent ash 1.6 km above its summit on 3 Nov; both are smaller events. GDACS listed no volcano alerts on 10 Nov, and no VEI 4+ eruption or major ash closure was found.
for_you: No volcanic ash disruption to major air routes is flagged. Travellers to the Philippines or Indonesia can follow FCDO travel advice and airline updates near active volcanoes.
rubric_hit: No aviation colour code red and no large eruption reported (to 10 Nov): Normal

drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
